d:
A man hallucinates.
Sean is, on the surface, an ordinary young man, working, going out with friends and dating. But he has a secret: he's obsessed with an ASMR artist named Vanessa, whose videos command his attention more than any real-life woman he meets.
Sean tries to date other women, but they can't compare to Vanessa's voice and face. But when he begins to experience hallucinations, the lines between reality and fantasy blur.
